name: tracker
description: What is being kept up, at a glance: each habit against its target for this day, week, month or year (at least the target, at most a limit, or no target when it only records), its streak, the last periods as dots, and a press to log. From the habit and entry records, kept current. At glance detail it is how many are met this period.

use.when: a person keeps something up and wants to see and log it without thinking: habits, a daily measure, a weekly distance, a monthly allowance of hours or a budget, a reading such as weight.
use.not: a one-off task, which is a task; or numbers over time on their own, which is a chart.
use.with: the habit records behind it, each with its own page, numbers and chart.

detail.title: How much to show
detail.description: glance is how many are met this period, for a corner. full is every habit with its bar, streak, days and Log.

tags.description: Show only habits with one of these tags. Leave out for all that are not archived.

habits.description: The habits as they stand. Filled in by the server from the records.

aim.description: reach is at least the target; limit is at most, and past it is over; record has no target and no bar.

dated.description: Log offers a day to log for, for something done before today, written as a person would: yesterday, 22 Sep, 2026-09-22. Empty is now. The habit's own page sets it.

on.description: With dated: the day filled in, as YYYY-MM-DD, such as the day a calendar's day view shows.

log.description: For a record: the amount Log starts at, the last reading, so the same again is one press. Anything else starts empty, and Log with nothing typed logs one.

progress.description: In words: 3 of 8 glasses, done, not yet.

pct.description: This period against the target, 0 to 100.

goal.description: Progress on a longer goal, in words; empty for none.

words.description: How the period went, for a reader, when met or not met does not say it: 24 hours, over the limit.

a11y.role: region at full, status at glance

keyboard.does: reaches each habit's name, the amount field when it has a unit, and Log

wcag.notes: A named region. Each bar is the meter component: its value, its target, and the amount in words as its value text, so the picture is never the only way to read it. The streak and each day dot carry their meaning in words for a reader. Log is a plain form that works without scripts. Colour marks a met day, and the word does too.

machine.identify: Each habit is a list item with data-id, data-met and data-aim (a limit's data-met is whether it is kept within); the progressbar carries aria-valuenow and aria-valuemax; the streak is .sw-tracker__streak.
machine.operate: To log, fill the amount (when there is one), the day when it was done before (when offered), and activate Log, which POSTs amount and on to /habit/{id}/log. The same is create_record on entry with the habit's id.

habits.name: Hours worked
habits.streakWords: 2 months in a row within the limit
